feeds.title: Michael Binkley Sculptor Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts by Canadian artist Michael Binkley regarding his sculpture, his art, and all things art and design related. Michael Binkley is among Canada's most successful self-represented artists. He has been a professional stone sculptor for over 35 years and maintains his studio, gallery and sculpture garden in North Vancouver, BC Canada.

feeds.title: colonialmexico
feeds.description: The blog features articles on the arts of colonial Mexico.

feeds.title: Restless Rocks
feeds.description: A blog that will describe the day to day activities of a professional stone sculptor, living and working in a remote wooded area of kentucky. The blog is a step-by-step guide for how to create monumental stone sculptures.

feeds.title: Melanie Wilks Blog
feeds.description: Melanie Wilks, based in Dewsbury West Yorkshire is a sculptor and artist who specialises in stone carving. Read the blog to find articles on carving of stone.

feeds.title: Schneible Fine Arts
feeds.description: Schneible Fine Arts is an Asian fine arts gallery specializing in antiquities, Japanese garden sculptures and lanterns, and Chinese dreamstone paintings.

feeds.title: Bartlett Stone Carving
feeds.description: A native of Andice, Texas, Matthew Johnson has over twenty-five years experience in the craft and business of stone carving. He is the owner and principal designer and carver of Bartlett Stone Company.

feeds.title: Simon Burns-Cox
feeds.description: This is the blog and news section of Simon Burns-Cox, Sculptor and Letter Carver. Simon Burns-Cox works primarily in Stone and Marble but also other media such as Slate, Granite, Alabaster, Wood and Metal.

feeds.title: Graeme Mitcheson Stone Sculptor
feeds.description: Graeme Mitcheson has been creating stone sculpture since graduating from Loughborough College of Art in 1995. Images of Graeme's work can be found in the gallery while details of Graeme's current projects as well as upcoming dates for stone carving courses and exhibitions can be found on his blog.
